subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral Jetson install guide in first-party docs after the NVIDIA setup facts are corrected, and should turnkey hardware references be omitted from that guide?
rationale: The linked issue explicitly asks for maintainer policy on first-party Jetson docs and turnkey hardware references, while VISION.md routes ecosystem promotion outside core docs.

options.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
options.body: Merge a corrected vendor-neutral Jetson guide once it matches current NVIDIA setup guidance and avoids commercial hardware promotion.

options.title: Keep Jetson Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson-specific setup in vendor, community, or ClawHub-owned surfaces.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Edge Notes
options.body: Replace the dedicated page with a smaller generic Linux/ARM note if maintainers want less first-party hardware surface.

recommendation.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
recommendation.body: Merge a corrected vendor-neutral Jetson guide once it matches current NVIDIA setup guidance and avoids commercial hardware promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about first-party docs and ecosystem-promotion boundaries, which recent VISION.md and docs-policy history tie most strongly to steipete.
